# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Native rendering reliability**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.159.0 update improves glyph rendering, image-filter caching and Vulkan allocation failure handling. These Skia m159 corrections leave managed APIs and the native ABI unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Match image-filter cache equality to hashing** — Cache keys use bytewise equality, consistently distinguishing signed zero and matrix type metadata regardless of runtime subnormal handling. This aligns lookups, LRU eviction and purge behavior with the existing hash. ([#5769](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5769))
- **Handle divergent glyph reloads safely** — Mask-filtered text rasterizes the reloaded glyph rather than stale outline state when font-scaler loads differ. Incompatible masks are cleared instead of overflowing sub-byte rows, and clipped embossed masks use full plane strides while overlapping SDF data is preserved. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
- **Avoid an Imagination Vulkan driver failure** — When descriptor-set allocation reports host or device out-of-memory on Imagination drivers, Skia abandons the affected pool rather than destroying it, avoiding a driver failure. The workaround is limited to that vendor and those allocation errors. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
